# Phase 4 results (generated by scripts/phase4_evaluate.py)

Config hash `f4021560ce9c` (Phase 3 `ae9db57acecd`, dataset `67da9d294be3`). Offline simulation, CPU-only burst-trace projection; no kernel-level measurement.

- `p4_selected`: **online_censored/logistic_classifier, m=5 {'C': 1.0}** (A + O + E features)
- `p4_ablation`: online_censored/tree_classifier, m=20 {'max_depth': 3, 'min_samples_leaf': 20} (the Phase 3 configuration retrained with E features)
- `p3_frozen`: online/tree_classifier, m=20 {'max_depth': 3, 'min_samples_leaf': 20} (A + O features)
- Validation (mean log ratio vs RR1): p4_selected -0.00536, p4_ablation -0.00287, p3_frozen -0.00467

Geo change = geometric mean of per-workload ratios of average turnaround (negative = better). Test: two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test of the mean log ratio; CI: paired percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples). Supported improvement = Holm p < 0.05 and CI upper bound < 0.
